decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the INA219 position and its downstream ESP32 and sensor-board measurement coverage; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.
The interboard power-chain clarification does not change which sensor modules are connected or their established 3.3V supply requirement.
The source describes normal interboard distribution and INA219 placement, without changing the standalone USB activation condition, regulator, powered load, or Schottky-OR source selection.
The power-distribution topology does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
The source does not alter the AXP2101 battery or USB input path, VMID/VSYS topology, or the established AXP2101 normal-operation supply role.
The interboard power chain and current-monitor placement do not change BOOT, reset, or associated capacitance requirements.
The source concerns power distribution and current measurement, not USB enumeration, data, or programming behavior.
Mentioning the ESP32 as a downstream load does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The electrical board-chain clarification does not change battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source establishes no GPIO assignment or compatibility change.
The electrical power topology does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting, enclosure fit, or USB-C placement.
The source uses existing connector designations but makes no component availability, sourcing, substitution, or cost decision.
